name: stick lunge with overhead raise stretch
description: A lunge combined with a stick held overhead. Opens the hip flexors of the back leg and the shoulders at the same time.
instructions: Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.
